base_rule: The existing Step 14 shrunk offense + opponent points-allowed + empirical home-field model remains the baseline and may not be displaced unless the challenger improves leakage-safe held-out results.

current_state_extensions.canonical_2026_team_state: Step 6.5B roster/personnel/coaching/injury state may be attached to the game record, but receives no numeric score adjustment until the corresponding coefficient is leakage-safe validated.
current_state_extensions.defense: Step 6.5C DST evidence may inform shared defensive state only through separately validated pathways; a DST fantasy score itself is not a team-points input.
current_state_extensions.kicker: Kicker quality/conditions may remain shared context, but the richer kicker model failed its 6.5C promotion test and therefore receives no new score-mean authority here.

prior_decay.rule: The prior season is the preseason/Week 1 marker and is gradually weeded out as current-season games accumulate. The decay rate is selected from historical walk-forward data, never hand-set for 2026.

walk_forward.parameter_selection: For each held-out season, select decay and regularization using earlier seasons only, then refit without the held-out season and grade the untouched held-out games.

baseline.method: Step 14 equivalent: prior historical/shrunk team scoring offense paired with opponent defensive points allowed plus empirical home field.

required: no held-out season has material regression in both margin and total error

market_separation.allowed_later: After the football forecast is frozen, historical/live market lines may be compared downstream for edge, ATS/total evaluation, EV and CLV.

missing_data_rule: Missing football fields are unknown, not zero; unavailable optional context is omitted rather than silently imputed from a sportsbook line.
double_count_rule: A football fact or adjustment may enter a team score pathway once. The same injury, defensive effect, rest effect or personnel effect may not be applied again downstream unless an explicitly validated decomposition prevents double counting.
distribution_rule: Margin/total uncertainty must be estimated from football forecast residuals or another leakage-safe football-only calibration, never inferred from bookmaker prices.
locked_rules: 2025 is the 2026 starting prior and is progressively weeded out as valid 2026 evidence accumulates.
Football forecasts are generated before market comparison.
Sportsbook/ADP inputs cannot create, tune or backsolve football score forecasts.
All Step 6.5D outputs remain SHADOW_ONLY with zero production authority pending later governance and the full backward audit.
